Delete one rubric item

Source: R/project.R
rubric_item_delete.Rd

Removes a single stored rubric item, leaving the rest of its question's rubric and every other recorded selection untouched: unlike a mode = "replace" rubric_import(), only this item's selections stop counting.

Usage

rubric_item_delete(
  question,
  item,
  project = ".",
  force = FALSE,
  snapshot = TRUE,
  summary = NULL
)

Arguments

question

Question name from the project's template.

item

Description of the item, matched verbatim.

project

Path to the project directory. Defaults to the working directory.

force

Whether to delete an item that repositories have selected without asking for confirmation.

snapshot

Whether to take an automatic snapshot before the change.

summary

Optional text recorded on the automatic snapshot and in the activity log: what the change is and why.

Value

Invisibly, the deleted markermd_rubric_item, or NULL when the deletion was declined.

Details

The item is identified by its description, matched verbatim as in rubric_item_set(). When some repository currently has the item selected, deleting it changes that repository's score and can leave the question ungraded for it, so the deletion has to be confirmed: an interactive session is asked, and a non-interactive one is refused unless force = TRUE. An item nobody has selected is deleted without asking.

The item is soft-deleted: its past selection events stay in the History tab, and restoring the automatic snapshot taken before the change (see snapshot_restore()) brings the item back with its selections. The remaining items keep their order and their hotkeys are renumbered. The change is recorded in the activity log (see project_activity()).

See also

rubric_item_set(), rubric_import(), snapshot_restore()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
rubric_item_delete("Q3", "Distance ordering is not explained",
  project = "hw03",
  summary = "Wording review: never selected, meaning unclear"
)
} # }
